g.text: Crash after confirmed publish but before DB commit can replay.
This is at-least-once delivery, NOT exactly-once messaging.
Duplicate enrollment under a different event ID is also ACKed
after rollback on the invoice uniqueness path.
UI polls every 2 s for the newly created enrollment.
Browser never connects directly to either database.
Activation bars: handler, query or broker-processing scope; not a distributed transaction.
Solid filled-arrow calls / dashed returns: synchronous request and response.
Open-arrow messages: asynchronous publication, delivery, confirmation and acknowledgement.
Database row locks outlive a query's activation until COMMIT / ROLLBACK.
